# connect_oauth_tool

> Get a link the USER clicks to connect a dynamic function's OAuth integration (Google, Microsoft, GitHub, ...), or check whether it is already connected.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | `dynamic_functions` |
| Callable | MCP clients; in-app @ai conversations; grantable to agents |
| Filter | `https://www.dsiloed.com/api/v1/mcp?tools=connect_oauth_tool` |

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

Get a link the USER clicks to connect a dynamic function's OAuth integration
(Google, Microsoft, GitHub, ...), or check whether it is already connected.

ACTIONS:
  status     - is this connection live? Returns configured/connected + scopes.
  connect    - returns authorize_url to give the user. THEY click it; you cannot.
  disconnect - revokes provider access and clears stored tokens. Unlike connect
               it needs no user click - do it when asked, then confirm via status.

You NEVER complete consent yourself. Post the url and say what they are granting.
After they confirm, call status again to VERIFY before claiming the integration
works - never report success on an unverified connection.

EXAMPLES:
  {action: "status",     function_name: "google_connection"}
  {action: "disconnect", function_name: "google_connection"}

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | string | yes | status, connect, or disconnect. One of: `status`, `connect`, `disconnect`. |
| `function_name` | string | yes | Name (or id) of the dynamic function holding the OAuth config. |
| `return_url` | string | no | Optional URL to send the user back to after consent. |
| `conversation_id` | string | no | The conversation you are in. PASS THIS: it is how the platform confirms back in chat when consent completes. |
| `tenant_id` | string | no | Tenant scope (defaults to the calling tenant) |
